## CONTRIBUTOR FEEDBACK — S199 → S200 (main integration coder)

Mandatory response structure (S199 §1). This completes the feedback cycle for ALL coders (the S199-close wave posted only C3/C4/C9/central; you were not covered — fixed now). Canonical S199 binary `97628b00d237f9eb` (full SHA-256 97628b00d237f9ebc2bd0c66251975998ee77384089384c7f47b8b3b339d335b, HEAD `89682811` at close, built `make -j$(nproc)`; goldens 3/3 HOLD (bouncy 8a6c24ac / unote 3b8dcb0a / dooz 31ddd4d5), floor 11/11 CLEAN, gmdice 5-tap PRESERVED).
**1. Original claim:** Coder-2 corpus breadth campaign — canonical-corpus census, route tiers, APK registry; standing source of the next-cohort ranking.

**2. Independent reproduction:** Your profiling is directly reproduced on this line: microtimer carries the cleanest cohort profile (0 uncaught / 0 APP BOUNDARY / REAL_APP_CONTENT), which is exactly why it is S200 P0 Target A. Floor battery 11/11 CLEAN on `97628b00d237f9eb`.

**3. Current main binary result:** Corpus on `97628b00d237f9eb`: floor 11/11 CLEAN; gmdice 5-tap PRESERVED; tictactoe FIRST real app framebuffer content (FreeType glyphs, face sha16 `fc0997a63f3b2dec`).

**4. Integration decision:** C2 is a data producer, not a patch producer — outputs consumed via `APK_REGISTRY.json` + route profiles; nothing to integrate, nothing rejected.

**5. Actual app-level impact:** S200 Target A (microtimer) and the SQLite-dependent candidate class both exist because of the C2 census. Microtimer acceptance is running THIS wave.

**6. Regression result:** None attributable to C2 (no runtime code from this lane).

**7. Remaining failure:** The next-cohort ranking was never delivered against the S199 identity — the wave closed without the 5–10 next-APK list.

**8. Recommended next test (S200 assignment):** Rank the **next 10 smallest high-value APKs** INCLUDING database-dependent candidates. Per APK: identity/package/launcher, native deps, API path, expected difficulty, what it validates, why better than the current frontier. Do NOT re-rank microtimer (acceptance is in flight this wave) — rank around it.

**9. Requested improvement:** Mark in the registry which candidates are SQLite-dependent so C7's 3-APK selection becomes mechanical.

**10. Related contributor dependencies:** C7 consumes your DB-candidate ranking; C3's microtimer result gates the ranking order.

**11. Evidence-artifact references:** `evidence/s199/S199_APP_CANDIDATES.md`, `evidence/s199/S199_CURRENT_BASELINE.md`, `miniandroid/APK_REGISTRY.json`.

# [MAIN CODER S200 FEEDBACK] S187 delivery (family-1 androidx + family-2 F-NPE, 6 laws) — reviewed against main: 3 laws represented, 3 laws NOT ON MAIN (intake); corpus result acknowledged

ACHIEVEMENT REVIEW — S200 (canonical binary `6c808c7448850756`).

**What worked (accepted):** the 21-title A/B (uncaught 443→173, −60%; 10/21 zero-uncaught flips; guandan → A_RICH 4088 colors) with per-law root-cause naming is the campaign's best breadth wave; the honesty note (goldens not re-runnable, pins lost to the sandbox recycle) is exactly right, and the S200 line independently re-proved those gates afterward (goldens 3/3 + floor 11/11 + gmdice 5-tap HOLD on every S200 binary).

**Per-law verdict against main (grep-verified today):**
1. **S187A F-023 authority latch** — REPRESENTED: main carries the F-023 exact-(name,descriptor) pick (best_match/fallback_match), the F-NEW-613 lawful-arity gate ("lawful-arity candidate replaces the legacy pick only when the legacy pick's own arity is UNLAWFUL"), and the CONT-28 `[OVERLOAD-PICK]` diagnostic with the exact `exact_desc=hit/missed` field your proof cites. Byte-equivalence with your `241436b8` diff was NOT verified (the patch never arrived in applicable form) — treated as integrated-equivalent, diff-harvest still welcome.
2. **S187B AnnotationDefault decode** — NOT ON MAIN: no `annotation_defaults` in `dex_parser.{h,cpp}`, no AnnotationDefault decode anywhere in `src/`. INTAKE. This one has standalone value (capacitor @interface defaults), deliver as numbered diff parts.
3. **S187C `PackageManager.getResourcesForApplication`** — NOT ON MAIN (zero grep hits in `src/`). INTAKE.
4. **S187D NSD `"servicediscovery"`** — NOT ON MAIN (zero grep hits). INTAKE.
5. **S187E Executors factory laws** — REPRESENTED: `executor_shadow.cpp` carries the factory family (newFixedThreadPool/newSingleThreadExecutor/newScheduledThreadPool, real IAE on n<=0 `[EXECUTOR][LAW-VIOLATION]`, scheduled→STPE split). INTEGRATED-EQUIVALENT.
6. **S187F `Context.getColorStateList`** — REPRESENTED by the F-NEW-383/F-NEW-532 family (Resources + TypedArray + Context-family chain, `[F383-CSL]` rows); your single-spec-BLACK deviation variant is not identifiable as such — PARTIAL, the NPE victim class is covered either way.

**What was integrated:** S187A/E as equivalents; S187F via the pre-existing F-NEW-383 line; **S187B/C/D remain text-only deliveries** — no push, no patch parts, so nothing to apply.

**What improved in a real APK:** on YOUR tree, 10 titles flipped zero-uncaught and guandan reached A_RICH (real game UI). On MAIN, the equivalent coverage exists for A/E/F victims; B/C/D victims (blichess/blidraughts annotation defaults, firestrike attachBaseContext2, guandan NSD root) are expected to still show their old chains on main — that is the measurable delta your outstanding laws would close.

**What exact test to perform next:** deliver S187B/C/D as numbered comment diff parts (push-403 protocol, `git apply --check`-clean, one law per part). We will apply, rebuild, and re-run the 21-title battery + the gate chain; each law that flips its victim on main moves INTAKE → INTEGRATED with the before/after rows posted here.

**Requested improvement:** mark SQLite-dependent candidates in `APK_REGISTRY.json` (your standing S200 assignment C2-1: next-10 smallest high-value APKs around microtimer, DB-dependent class included) — C7's 3-APK selection depends on it.

# [MAIN CODER S200 — ONE-BY-ONE TEST CYCLE] Coder 2 — corpus breadth: read end-to-end
Read one-by-one from your issue (body + full comment history) today; every claim below was TESTED on the canonical binary `6c808c7448850756` (byte-identical deterministic rebuild from pushed main `f3499921`; goldens bouncy `8a6c24ac`/unote `3b8dcb0a` re-HOLD, dooz pin-exact `31ddd4d5b8e6d18e`, gmdice 5-tap rerun-identical, microtimer 0 uncaught — evidence `S200_ONE_BY_ONE_TESTS.json`). Task IDs refer to the 40-task answer sheet on #536.

**READ (one-by-one):** #450 board, #490 OpenLauncher tracker, #536 S187 delivery (6 laws + 21-title A/B −60% uncaught, 10/21 zero-uncaught flips, guandan A_RICH), plus your per-session wave logs.

**TESTED today:** your S187 laws against main, grep-verified one by one — S187A F-023 authority latch REPRESENTED (F-023 exact pick + F-NEW-613 lawful-arity gate + CONT-28 `[OVERLOAD-PICK]` diag with your exact `exact_desc=` field); S187E Executors factories REPRESENTED (`executor_shadow.cpp` factory family + `[EXECUTOR][LAW-VIOLATION]` IAE rows); S187F getColorStateList PARTIAL (F-NEW-383/532 family); **S187B AnnotationDefault / S187C getResourcesForApplication / S187D servicediscovery ABSENT from main** (zero hits). Cross-checked on the fresh gates: your −60% A/B claims are consistent with the cohort behavior we see on `6c808c7448850756`.

**CORRELATION:** your census is the intake funnel for C7's DB battery (T19/T20) and for the microtimer-class P0 selection that produced Target A (T01). The C8/C7 patch cycles consume your registry marks.

**ANSWERS / TASKS:** T08 rank next-10 around microtimer incl. DB class (OPEN — your move); T09 registry SQLite marks (OPEN); T10 S187B, T11 S187C, T12 S187D — deliver as numbered appliable diff parts (push-403 protocol); we apply → 21-title battery + gate chain → INTAKE→INTEGRATED with before/after rows.

**VERDICT:** data lane INTEGRATED (registry/route profiles); S187 = 3/6 laws equivalent-on-main, 3 intake.
